newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's MontePaschi cuts prime, aligns with others.
newsitem.headline: Italy's MontePaschi cuts prime, aligns with others.

text.p: Italian bank Monte dei Paschi di Siena brought its prime lending rate down 50 basis points to 9.0 percent on Monday, aligning it with other Italian retail banks.
Monte dei Paschi said in a statement it was also lowering its top lending rate by the same margin to 16.75 percent.
The move follows a 50 basis point cut in official rates by the Bank of Italy on Friday, which reduced the discount rate to 6.25 percent and the fixed terms advances to 7.75 percent.
Other Italian banks, including San Paolo di Torino, already have prime rates at 9.0 percent or below having cut earlier in the year after the last Bank of Italy rate move in January.
Popolare Novara and Banca Sella have prime rates at 8.75 percent.
